    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]

    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i,r in enumerate(g):
        c=[j for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==fg]
        for a,b in zip(c,c[1:]):
            if b-a==2: out[i][a+1]=2
    return out
